name: Protein Pizza
steps: Mix the flour and greek yogurt to form a dough.
Roll out the dough and place it on a baking sheet.
Spread pizza sauce over the dough.
Add cheese, pepperoni, and sliced red onion on top.
Bake in the oven for 15-20 minutes or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Remove from the oven and start slicing and serving.
